controls.title: Access removed when people leave
controls.statement: Access to systems is removed on the day a person leaves, and reviewed when they change role.

controls.title: Access reviewed
controls.statement: Owners of sensitive systems confirm twice a year that everyone with access still needs it.

controls.title: Second factor at sign-in
controls.statement: Signing in from outside the organization, or to anything holding restricted data, needs a second factor.

controls.title: Administrative access limited
controls.statement: Administrative rights are held by named people, used from separate accounts, and recorded.

controls.title: Devices and storage encrypted
controls.statement: Laptops, portable drives, and storage that hold confidential or restricted data are encrypted.

controls.title: Backups tested by restoring
controls.statement: Critical data is backed up to a place an attacker on the network cannot reach, and a restore is tested every quarter.

controls.title: Data classified and handled accordingly
controls.statement: Each body of data has a class, and where it may be stored and shared follows from that class.

controls.title: Data sharing approved
controls.statement: Sharing restricted data outside the organization needs an agreement in place and a named approver.

controls.title: Systems kept patched
controls.statement: Security updates are applied within a set time, and systems that cannot be patched are isolated and listed.

controls.title: Protection against malicious software
controls.statement: Servers and workstations run managed protection that is monitored centrally.

controls.title: Networks separated
controls.statement: Instruments, clinical devices, and systems that cannot be patched sit on networks separated from general use.

controls.title: Unsupported systems listed and contained
controls.statement: Each system that no longer receives updates has an owner, an end date, and compensating safeguards.

controls.title: Changes reviewed and reversible
controls.statement: Changes to critical systems are tested, approved by a second person, and can be undone.

controls.title: Security events monitored
controls.statement: Sign-ins and administrative actions on critical systems are logged and watched, and alerts are acted on.

controls.title: Incident response rehearsed
controls.statement: There is a written plan for a security incident, with named roles, and it is exercised each year.

controls.title: Security awareness training
controls.statement: Everyone completes security training when they join and each year, and phishing exercises are run.

controls.title: Access approved before it is given
controls.statement: Access to a system is requested, approved by the system's owner, limited to what the role needs, and recorded.

controls.title: Everyone signs in as themselves
controls.statement: Each person has an account of their own, shared accounts are not used, and passwords meet a written standard.

controls.title: Screens lock and sessions end
controls.statement: Workstations lock after a short time unused, repeated failed sign-ins lock the account, and idle sessions are ended.

controls.title: Remote and wireless access controlled
controls.statement: Access from outside comes through managed gateways, wireless networks are separated and encrypted, and personal and mobile devices reach only what is approved.

controls.title: People screened and bound by rules of use
controls.statement: People are screened as their role requires before they are given access, agree to the rules for using systems, and know what follows from breaking them.

controls.title: Information encrypted in transit
controls.statement: Connections that carry confidential or restricted data are encrypted with current protocols, inside the network and out.

controls.title: Devices and media wiped before they leave
controls.statement: Storage is erased or destroyed before a device is reused, returned, or disposed of, and a record is kept.

controls.title: Systems and software inventoried
controls.statement: Hardware, software, and services are listed with an owner, and the list is checked against what is found on the network.

controls.title: Systems built to a secure standard
controls.statement: Servers, workstations, and network devices are built from a hardened standard with only what they need, and drift from it is found and corrected.

controls.title: Vulnerabilities found and followed up
controls.statement: Systems are scanned for known weaknesses on a schedule, advisories are read, and what is found is ranked, assigned, and followed to closure.

controls.title: Logs kept and protected
controls.statement: Logs from critical systems go to a central store, are kept for a set time, are protected from change, and take their time from one clock.

controls.title: Security incidents reported and followed up
controls.statement: Anyone can report a suspected incident at any hour. Each one is triaged, contained, recorded, reviewed afterwards, and reported to those who must be told.

controls.title: Recovery of systems planned and tested
controls.statement: Critical systems have a recovery plan with an order of restoration and target times, and it is tested each year.

controls.title: Physical access to systems limited
controls.statement: Data rooms, network closets, and rooms with sensitive equipment are locked, entry is limited to named people and recorded, and visitors are escorted.

controls.title: Security policies kept current
controls.statement: Written security policies and standards are approved by leadership, reviewed each year, kept with their earlier versions, and available to everyone they bind.

controls.title: Security responsibilities assigned
controls.statement: A named person answers for security, and the roles and authority of everyone with a part in it are written down.

controls.title: Security reported to leadership
controls.statement: Leadership says how much security risk it will take, hears where security stands at least twice a year, and decides what is resourced.

controls.title: Security risks assessed
controls.statement: Risks to systems and information are assessed each year and when something significant changes, and the result decides what is done.

controls.title: Security assessed independently
controls.statement: Each year the controls are assessed, and a penetration test is run, by people who do not operate the systems, and what they find is tracked to closure.

controls.title: Use of AI tools reviewed
controls.statement: A new AI tool, or a new use of one with sensitive data, is reviewed before use, and approved tools are listed.

controls.title: Cold storage monitored and alarmed
controls.statement: Freezers and liquid nitrogen stores are monitored continuously, and an alarm reaches a person who can respond at any hour.

controls.title: Critical equipment maintained
controls.statement: Critical equipment is maintained on a schedule under contract, and the records are kept.

controls.title: Irreplaceable material held in two places
controls.statement: Irreplaceable specimens are divided between two locations with separate power and cooling.

controls.title: Backup power tested under load
controls.statement: Generators and their fuel supply are tested under load each month, and critical equipment is confirmed to be on backup circuits.

controls.title: Spare capacity kept ready
controls.statement: Empty backup freezers and spare critical parts are kept ready for use.

controls.title: Environment monitored
controls.statement: Temperature, humidity, and air handling in laboratories, animal rooms, and data rooms are monitored and alarmed.

controls.title: Laboratory safety training and inspection
controls.statement: People who work with hazardous materials are trained before they start, and laboratories are inspected each year.

controls.title: Continuity plans exercised
controls.statement: Critical services have a plan for carrying on without their systems or space, and it is exercised each year.

controls.title: Animal facilities checked daily
controls.statement: Animal rooms are checked every day, weekends included, and environmental alarms reach on-call staff.

controls.title: Protocols tracked to renewal
controls.statement: Every study's approvals, amendments, and consent versions are tracked, with reminders before anything lapses.

controls.title: Research records kept to a standard
controls.statement: Laboratories keep records to a written standard, in a system the organization holds, and they stay when people leave.

controls.title: Research integrity training and review
controls.statement: Researchers are trained in responsible conduct, and data is reviewed within the lab before publication.

controls.title: Outside interests disclosed and reviewed
controls.statement: Researchers disclose outside support, appointments, and interests each year and when they change, and disclosures are checked against applications.

controls.title: Controlled items identified at the start
controls.statement: Projects are screened for controlled technology, information, and restricted parties before work begins.

controls.title: Agreements recorded with their terms
controls.statement: Each award and data use agreement is recorded with its conditions and an owner who answers for meeting them.

controls.title: Standards tracked all year
controls.statement: Each license and accreditation has an owner who tracks its standards and keeps the evidence current all year.

controls.title: Two identifiers before any procedure
controls.statement: Identity is confirmed with two identifiers before any test, treatment, or specimen collection.

controls.title: High-risk medication double-checked
controls.statement: High-risk medications are checked independently by a second person or by scanning before they are given.

controls.title: Infection prevention audited
controls.statement: Hand hygiene, cleaning, and isolation practice are audited each month and the results shared.

controls.title: Downtime procedures practiced
controls.statement: Clinical areas keep procedures for working without their systems, and practice them twice a year.

controls.title: Trials monitored against protocol
controls.statement: Each trial is monitored against its protocol, and deviations are reviewed and reported.

controls.title: Deterioration recognized and escalated
controls.statement: Vital signs are scored at set intervals, and a score above the threshold brings a rapid response.

controls.title: Charges to awards reviewed
controls.statement: Charges to sponsored awards are reviewed against the award's terms each month by someone trained in them.

controls.title: Effort certified on time
controls.statement: Effort charged to awards is certified by someone with direct knowledge, within the set period.

controls.title: Subrecipients assessed and monitored
controls.statement: Subrecipients are assessed before funds are passed to them, and their reports and invoices are reviewed.

controls.title: Changes to payment details verified
controls.statement: A request to change bank details is confirmed by calling a known number before any payment is made.

controls.title: Purchasing duties separated
controls.statement: Nobody both requests and approves a purchase, and card spending is reviewed each month.

controls.title: Budgets monitored and reserves held
controls.statement: Income and spending are compared with plan each month, and reserves are held to a set level.

controls.title: Gift restrictions recorded and checked
controls.statement: The terms of each restricted gift are recorded, and spending from it is checked against them.

controls.title: Knowledge shared and deputies named
controls.statement: Critical roles have a named deputy, and the knowledge they depend on is written down.

controls.title: Required training tracked
controls.statement: Required training is recorded in one place, and people are reminded before it lapses.

controls.title: A safe way to raise concerns
controls.statement: Concerns can be raised in confidence and are followed up, and retaliation is not tolerated.

controls.title: Workload and staffing reviewed
controls.statement: Leaders review workload, vacancies, and turnover each quarter and act on what they find.

controls.title: Suppliers assessed before use
controls.statement: A supplier that will hold restricted data or run a critical service is assessed before it is engaged, and again on a schedule.

controls.title: Required agreements in place
controls.statement: No regulated information is shared with a third party until the agreement it requires is signed.

controls.title: A second source identified
controls.statement: For each critical material or service, a second source has been identified and, where possible, qualified.

controls.title: A way out of each critical service
controls.statement: For each critical hosted service, the organization knows how it would get its data back and carry on elsewhere.

controls.title: Funding sources watched and spread
controls.statement: Leadership reviews the mix of funding each year and sets limits on dependence on any one source.

controls.title: Sensitive issues anticipated
controls.statement: Sensitive work is identified in advance, and there is a plan for who speaks and what is said.
